_description: PR-label → upstream-test-subset mapping for label-driven post-merge runs. Consumed by runner/label_selection.py via emit_upstream_matrix.py. See runner/label_selection.py for the matching algorithm.

_kinds.full_suite: Terminator — when any matching label has this kind, the dist config passes through unfiltered. Use for labels that imply 'this could affect anything' (runtime-core). For other broad-impact PRs (build, ci), reviewers can manually add ciflow:run-full-suite.
_kinds.items: Subset selection — the union of `items` across matching labels filters the dist config nodes. A node is kept if any of its items appears in the union.

module:build._comment: Build-config changes (setup.py, pyproject, CMake, Bazel) usually break loudly: an import-time failure will surface in any test that loads torch_neuronx, so the smallest representative subset is enough to validate. For a build change that only affects a specific code path's compile flags, reviewers can manually add ciflow:run-full-suite.

module:upstream-test-infra._comment: Upstream test-infra changes (runner, conftest, dist config under tests/pytorch_tests_native/, excluding skip_registry which is metadata-only and labeled as module:ci). Plumbing rather than behavior — the smallest representative subset is enough to validate. Reviewers can manually add ciflow:run-full-suite when a runner-internals change warrants the safety net.
